info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Facilities Site Administration By Site Administration Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information regarding specific banking facilities associated with a particular site administration identifier. It facilitates administrators and stakeholders in managing and reviewing site-related banking facilities effectively. Typical consumers of this API include financial services operators, site managers, and developers building financial applications. By utilizing this endpoint, users can ensure they have accurate and current data for decision-making and operational planning.
